name: elevenlabs
description: ElevenLabs TTS for Claude Code: a localhost voice server, a CLI (speak/status/voices), and a Stop hook that narrates each turn's summary; paid calls ceilinged in code and audited with the character count, voice creation behind --yes; plus Eleven Music composition (`music`, paid, --yes)
surface: CLI + a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server. `speak` is paid per character: refused above MAX_CHARS=1000 (code constant, server-side 422), `--yes` above 400 chars, every TTS call writes an audit line with the char count to stderr and ~/.local/state/agent-voice/audit.log. `voices` reads. `voice-add` creates a voice in the account only with `--yes`. `setup` writes ~/.claude (hook + settings) only with `--yes` after a preview; no delete verb exists; plus Eleven Music composition (`music`, paid, --yes)

origin.note: source tree was dirty at copy time; only committed files were taken. Dropped on vendor: .claude/ (per-repo permissions and the /up-voice /down-voice commands — the router skill and `agent-voice status` replace them) and README.md (folded into CLAUDE.md). The untracked scripts/narrate_file.py (long-form MP3 narration) was not vendored

install.description: Create the in-project .venv and install the locked dependencies (elevenlabs SDK, FastAPI, uvicorn, click, httpx)
install.why: the CLI and the server import these; poetry.toml pins the venv to tools/elevenlabs/.venv so nothing lands in a global site-packages
install.yes: .venv/ is created inside tools/elevenlabs from poetry.lock; no call to ElevenLabs is made
install.no: skipped; every agent-voice command fails on import until you run it

install.description: Install the Claude Code Stop hook: copy scripts/agent-voice-hook.sh to ~/.claude/hooks/ and add a Stop entry to ~/.claude/settings.json
install.why: this is the only thing in the tool that writes outside its own directory, so it is a declared step you confirm, not a side effect of install. The hook fires on every Stop in every session; with the server down it is a 2-second curl to nothing and exits 0
install.yes: ~/.claude/hooks/agent-voice-hook.sh is written (mode 755) and ~/.claude/settings.json gains one Stop hook entry (other hooks untouched; an existing entry is left as is). Undo: poetry run agent-voice setup --uninstall --yes
install.no: nothing outside tools/elevenlabs changes; the CLI and server still work, nothing narrates automatically; the doctor keeps reporting the hook as not installed (warn)

env.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
env.description: Your own ElevenLabs API key (elevenlabs.io > Profile > API keys). Read from the env, else the macOS Keychain item with service ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or elevenlabs-api-key), else ~/.config/toolbelt/elevenlabs.env (mode 600 enforced); an in-tree .env is a deprecated fallback that warns on stderr

env.name: AGENT_VOICE_PORT
env.description: Port the server binds on 127.0.0.1 and the CLI/hook send to (default 7888)

env.name: AGENT_VOICE_AUDIT_LOG
env.description: Where the audit line is appended (default ~/.local/state/agent-voice/audit.log, mode 600)

auth.flow: A personal ElevenLabs API key, billed to the operator's own account; resolved by get_api_key() in agent_voice/config.py and never printed, logged or placed on argv
auth.login: security add-generic-password -s ELEVENLABS_API_KEY -a "$USER" -w   (then paste the key at the prompt)

caches.note: the preferred store: a generic password, account $USER; get_api_key() reads the canonical service name first, then the lowercase name older ElevenLabs projects on this Mac used
caches.revoke: Delete the key at elevenlabs.io > Profile > API keys; security delete-generic-password -s ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or -s elevenlabs-api-key)

caches.note: optional 600-mode dotenv file holding ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; refused when group/world readable. The Keychain item is the preferred store
caches.revoke: Delete the key at elevenlabs.io > Profile > API keys; security delete-generic-password -s ELEVENLABS_API_KEY

safeguards: Paid-call ceiling in code: MAX_CHARS=1000 in agent_voice/config.py (mirrored in models.py, asserted equal by the tests). SpeakRequest refuses a longer body with HTTP 422 before any TTS call, speaker.py re-checks it, and the CLI exits 2 naming the constant. Raising it is a diff (SENSIBILITIES #3)
Bulk-spend guard at the CLI: `speak` above CONFIRM_CHARS=400 needs --yes (cli.py speak); --yes is always honored, so a deliberate narration is never refused (SENSIBILITIES #2 flag tier)

Audit line on every paid call and every write: audit() in agent_voice/audit.py prints `[agent-voice audit] <ts> verb=speak agent= voice= model= chars=N` to stderr and appends it to ~/.local/state/agent-voice/audit.log (dir 700, file 600); voice-add and setup audit the same way. Never the key, never the full text (SENSIBILITIES #7)
Pre-flight: `speak --dry-run` and `voice-add --dry-run` print the plan (chars, voice, model, bytes) and make no call (SENSIBILITIES #5)

voice-add creates a voice only with --yes (cli.py voice_add: without it the plan prints and the command exits 2); after the create it re-reads the voice by id and reports verified true/false (SENSIBILITIES #2 read-back)

setup is the only code path that writes outside the tool dir (hook_install.apply); the CLI reaches it only with --yes after printing the exact settings entry and the script action, and the `toolbelt setup elevenlabs` install step is that same command, confirmed at a terminal. --uninstall --yes is the undo
The server binds 127.0.0.1 only (server.py main) — the hook and CLI are its only intended clients; the Stop hook sends at most 200 characters (scripts/agent-voice-hook.sh) and always exits 0
No delete verb: voices are removed in the ElevenLabs UI; the SDK's voices.delete is not wired

The key is resolved by get_api_key() from $ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, the Keychain, or a 600-mode file; a group/world-readable key file is refused, and `status` reports only the key's source (SENSIBILITIES #6, #11)

Music ceiling in code: MAX_MUSIC_SECONDS=120 in agent_voice/config.py; `music` previews its plan (model, length, instrumental, output path, key source) and composes only with --yes, writes one file inside --out with O_EXCL, and audits the usage-counter delta as the credits charged (SENSIBILITIES #3, #5, #7)

verbs.name: status
verbs.note: server health, key source (never the key), ffplay, hook state; exit 1 when the server is down

verbs.name: voices
verbs.note: lists the account's voices via the API; --limit ceiling 100

verbs.name: serve
verbs.note: starts the 127.0.0.1 server; it spends only per /speak request, each ceilinged at MAX_CHARS and audited

verbs.name: stop
verbs.note: halts playback on the local server

verbs.name: speak
verbs.note: paid per character, private account: refused above MAX_CHARS=1000; --yes above CONFIRM_CHARS=400; --dry-run previews; audit line on every call

verbs.name: voice-add
verbs.note: creates an instant voice clone in your account: --yes required, --dry-run previews, read-back after create; undo in the ElevenLabs UI

verbs.name: setup
verbs.note: writes ~/.claude/hooks/agent-voice-hook.sh and a Stop entry in ~/.claude/settings.json (or ./.claude with --project): previews, --yes writes, --uninstall --yes reverts

verbs.name: music
verbs.note: Eleven Music compose (music_v2_5), paid by track length on your plan: previews without --yes (exit 2), refused above MAX_MUSIC_SECONDS=120, instrumental unless --vocals, one .mp3 inside --out, never overwrites; audit line with the credits the account counter moved

verbs.name: voice delete / edit / share
verbs.note: in the SDK; the belt exposes no path

risk.worst_case: ElevenLabs characters billed to the operator's own account — at most MAX_CHARS=1000 per request, each audited — or up to MAX_MUSIC_SECONDS=120 of composed music per call, or a voice added to their account; nothing shared, nothing deleted

checks.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY

smoke_test.command: poetry run agent-voice speak 'smoke test' --dry-run >/dev/null && poetry run agent-voice setup >/dev/null && poetry run python -m unittest discover -s tests
smoke_test.expect: after poetry install: the speak pre-flight prints its plan with no server and no key; setup previews and writes nothing; unit tests green (ceilings, --yes gates, hook install plan/apply in a temp dir, audit line format and 600 mode, loose key file refused) — no network, no credential
